scenario.topic: Pick a costume theme for the carnival float

options.name: Underwater Adventure
options.upside: Visually vibrant with diverse costume ideas like fish, mermaids, and sea creatures.
options.concern: Requires materials that may be delicate and less durable in windy conditions.

options.name: Classic Circus
options.upside: Simple costumes such as clowns, ringmasters, and acrobats that are easy to assemble.
options.concern: Theme may feel less unique and more common at public events.

options.name: Space Explorers
options.upside: Futuristic and eye-catching with potential for creative props and LED elements.
options.concern: Higher cost and complexity may require more preparation time.

options.name: Vintage 1920s
options.upside: Elegant and recognizable style with flapper dresses, suits, and hats.
options.concern: May limit movement and comfort due to formal costume styles.

shared_context: The group must select a costume theme for the carnival float that suits four participants and fits within a moderate budget. Each theme should be visually cohesive and appropriate for a public parade setting.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a creative graphic designer who loves vibrant and thematic costumes.
personas.private_goal: She wants a visually striking theme that allows for colorful and diverse costumes.

A.reason_for: Visually vibrant with diverse costume ideas fitting her creative style.

B.reason_for: Simple and easy costumes but less visually exciting.
B.reason_against: Feels less unique and not as colorful as preferred.

C.reason_for: Futuristic and eye-catching but too costly and complex.
C.reason_against: Higher cost and complexity may be a burden.

D.reason_for: Elegant style is appealing and suitable for a public parade.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a tech enthusiast who enjoys futuristic and innovative concepts.
personas.private_goal: He wants a theme that is creative and stands out with modern elements.

A.reason_for: Visually vibrant and creative, suits warm weather.
A.reason_against: Materials may be delicate and less durable.

B.reason_for: Easy to assemble costumes but too common and unoriginal.
B.reason_against: Theme feels less unique and uninspired.

C.reason_for: Futuristic and eye-catching with creative props and LED elements.

D.reason_for: Elegant and recognizable style that works in all weather.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an event coordinator who values simplicity and practicality.
personas.private_goal: She wants a low-complexity theme that is budget-friendly and easy to manage.

A.reason_for: Visually vibrant and fitting for warm weather.
A.reason_against: Materials may be delicate and less durable in windy conditions.

B.reason_for: Simple costumes easy to assemble and budget-friendly.

C.reason_for: Too costly and complex for the budget and time constraints.
C.reason_against: Higher cost and complexity may require more preparation time.

D.reason_for: Elegant and suitable for all weather with moderate complexity.
D.reason_against: Formal styles may limit comfort and movement.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a marketing specialist who prefers bold and memorable themes.
personas.private_goal: He wants a theme that is elegant yet stands out in a crowd.

A.reason_for: Vibrant and diverse costumes that attract attention.
A.reason_against: Materials may be delicate and less durable in windy conditions.

B.reason_for: Simple and easy costumes but too common and less impactful.
B.reason_against: Theme may feel less unique and more common.

C.reason_for: Futuristic and eye-catching but costly and complex.
C.reason_against: Higher cost and complexity may require more preparation time.

D.reason_for: Elegant and recognizable style that fits his preference for boldness.
